# A late client receives the authoritative snapshot after replaying any # events following its cursor, then receives committed live events. with client.websocket_connect( f"ws://localhost/ws/runs/{run_id}?after={cursor}", headers={"origin": "http://localhost"}, ) as socket: initial = socket.receive_json() assert initial["type"] == "snapshot" assert initial["snapshot"]["last_event_sequence"] == cursor
